newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC ON THE RALLY, NEW HIGHS SEEN.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC ON THE RALLY, NEW HIGHS SEEN.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter market (OTC) ended up on Tuesday amid strong buying interest in high-caps, mainly oil refineries, traders said.
Operators forecast new highs throughout the week with investors' interest focusing on oil, cement and metals.
On Tuesday, 134 stocks prices climbed, 109 slipped and 323 remained unchanged.

Independent indices VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, and BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, rose to 3,707.9 and 2,732.89 points respectively, increases of 1.2 percent and 2.01 percent. Both indices are computed on the baiss of average prices of OTC listings.
Strong buying pressure in oil refineries pushed up their closing prices.
Petrobrazi and Petromidia oil refineries closed both 2,500 lei firmer at 26,000 and 21,000 respectively, while Arpechim, another oil refinery, gained 2,000 lei to close at 30,000.
Cement makers were relatively stable with light swings of their prices, traders said.
Romcim, one of the most atractive cement makers for investors in recent months, firmed 1,100 lei to close at 70,100. Moldocim, another cement maker, inched up 500 lei to close at 30,000.
Wire maker Ductil was one of the most heavily traded listings on Tuesday with more than 242,000 shares changing hands. Ductil ended 500 lei higher at 1,500 under buying pressure.
Tuesday's turnover inched down to 12.3 billion lei from 12.4 billion on Monday, with over than 3.02 million shares traded.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD.
